method: Stream every non-directory ZIP entry, remove the single SKRU1_ACTUAL_DATA_TABLES_v1/ prefix, then compare entry length and SHA-256 with the corresponding extracted file.
rationale: The extracted tree is already versioned. Committing the 63 MB distribution archive would duplicate all 241 files without adding source content.
recovery_note: The local archive is retained in place and can be deleted later without losing versioned content; it is not required to reproduce a clean clone.
